changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: a live looper on one track (the LOOP&FADE machine) and a crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs, as one module.
CAPT and ONCE catch the loop playing now with FILL or UP; PICK keeps it playing through pattern changes with no trigs, and PTCH or WARP follow the tempo.
The crossfader sits on LEVEL on the Internal Mixer and on the tracks you choose, and on a CC on FX CONTROL CH. Settings are on SETTINGS > CROSSFADER.
Based on sumedho's RAM Machines, with its own single LOOP&FADE machine; it cannot be combined with RAM Machines or Digi Health.
Known issues: the loop is lost at power-off; a small click ends each take; changing PLAY mode mid-play restarts the loop; an open Overbridge instance slows the unit.
